description: This file defines an interface for savings product write operations such as create, update, and delete within the Fineract project.

classes.name: SavingsProductWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for creating, updating, and deleting savings products.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new savings product based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing savings product identified by productId with data from the JSON command.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the savings product identified by productId.
